ledger.x: c. 880: Oleg rules the Rus' from Novgorod. Infobox: established c. 880; Oleg 'is narrated to have succeeded Rurik as the ruler of Novgorod in 879'. The Rus' Khaganate page calls the pre-Kiev polity 'a hypothetical polity' whose seat is 'actively disputed'; no page gives a boundary, so the region is…
882: the capital moves from Novgorod to Kiev.
883: Oleg conquers the Drevlians. the Kievan Rus' page has Oleg conquering the Drevlians in 883 and imposing a fur tribute; the Oleg page: 'In 883, Oleg made the Drevlians pay tribute to Kiev.'
969: Sviatoslav moves his seat to the Danube.
983: Vladimir subdues the Yatvingians ('in 983, he subdued the Yatvingians').
989: Chersonesos not in the Rus' shape.
990: Tmutarakan is Rus' by Cliopatria's 990 shape.
1054: Yaroslav dies and Rus' is divided among his sons.

wars.name: Oleg's campaign against Constantinople
wars.outcome: No territorial result on the page, which names 'the Kievan military campaign against the Byzantine Empire' in 907 and 'the Russo-Byzantine treaties of 911 and 944'.

wars.name: Sviatoslav's campaign against the Khazars
wars.outcome: Sviatoslav 'destroyed the Khazar city of Sarkel around 965', settled Belaya Vyezha there and 'subsequently destroyed the Khazar capital of Atil'; the Khazar heartland was not occupied.

wars.name: Rus'-Byzantine War (Sviatoslav in Bulgaria)
wars.outcome: Sviatoslav defeated Boris II, took Philippopolis and sat at Pereyaslavets; in the treaty of 971 he 'agreed to abandon the Balkans, renounce his claims to the southern Crimea, and return west of the Dnieper River'.

wars.name: Vladimir's seizure of the Cherven towns
wars.outcome: 'In 981, he seized the Cherven towns from the Duchy of Poland.'

wars.name: Vladimir's Yatvingian and Radimich campaigns
wars.outcome: 'in 983, he subdued the Yatvingians'; 'in 984, he conquered the Radimichs'.

wars.name: Vladimir's Volga Bulgar campaign
wars.outcome: 'in 985, he conducted a military campaign against the Volga Bulgars', 'planting numerous fortresses and colonies on his way'; the page gives no territorial result.

wars.name: Siege of Chersonesos
wars.outcome: 'In 988, having taken the town of Chersonesus in Crimea' Vladimir bargained for Basil II's sister and was baptized; the page does not say whether the town was returned.

wars.name: Yaroslav's war with Sviatopolk
wars.outcome: Yaroslav defeated Sviatopolk in 1016; Sviatopolk 'returned in 1018 with Polish troops' and seized Kiev; in 1019 Yaroslav 'firmly established his rule over Kiev'.

wars.name: War of Yaroslav and Mstislav
wars.outcome: 'Mstislav inflicted a heavy defeat on Yaroslav in 1024'; they 'divided Kievan Rus' between them' along the Dnieper; Mstislav held the east bank 'until his death in 1036'.

wars.name: Yaroslav's Estonian raid
wars.outcome: 'Yaroslav captured Tartu, Estonia, and renamed it Yuryev'.

wars.name: Rus'-Polish war over the Cherven towns
wars.outcome: 'In 1031, he conquered Cherven cities from the Poles'.

wars.name: Pecheneg siege of Kiev
wars.outcome: Yaroslav won 'a decisive victory over the Pechenegs near Kiev in 1036'; no territorial result on the page.

wars.name: Rus'-Byzantine War (1043)
wars.outcome: 'Yaroslav presented his second direct challenge to Constantinople in 1043'; the Byzantines refused the money and a storm left the fleet nearly destroyed.

certainty.note: Tribal frontiers on the forest edge and the steppe, never fixed by a treaty or survey; the Byzantine treaties of 911 and 971 fix no boundary on the pages opened.
